lemma factorial_telescope (i : ℕ) :
    (i + 1) * Nat.factorial (i + 1) = Nat.factorial (i + 2) - Nat.factorial (i + 1) := by
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ (i + 1), Nat.factorial_succ i]
  ring_nf
  <;> omega

/-- Helper lemma: factorial grows, so (i+2)! ≥ (i+1)! -/

lemma factorial_mono (i : ℕ) :
    Nat.factorial (i + 1) ≤ Nat.factorial (i + 2) := by
  have : i + 1 ≤ i + 2 := by omega
  exact Nat.factorial_le this

/-- Helper lemma: (n+1)! ≥ 1 for all n -/

lemma factorial_ge_one (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by
  have : 0 < Nat.factorial (n + 1) := Nat.factorial_pos (n + 1)
  exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt this

/-- Helper lemma: (n+2)! - (n+1)! ≥ 1 -/

lemma factorial_diff_ge_one (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ Nat.factorial (n + 2) - Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by
  have h₁ : Nat.factorial (n + 2) - Nat.factorial (n + 1) = (n + 1) * Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ (n + 1), Nat.factorial_succ n]
    ring_nf
    <;> omega
  rw [h₁]
  exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.factorial_pos _))
